You can manage the devices and services associated with your Mozilla account in your [https://accounts.firefox.com/settings account settings]. Check out some frequently asked questions and additional resources below.

__TOC__

=Why can't I see my device in the ''Connected Services'' list?=
The devices currently connected to your Mozilla account can be viewed in your [https://accounts.firefox.com/settings account settings] under ''Connected Services''.

Your device could be missing if you are using an outdated version of Firefox desktop, please [[Update Firefox to the latest release|update to the latest version]].

If you are using the latest version of Firefox desktop, [[How do I choose what information to sync on Firefox?#w_manage-sync-information-on-a-computer|make sure your Sync is set to '''On''']].

=Why do I see duplicates in the ''Connected Services'' list?=
If you see a device or service listed multiple times (and you're sure that it is the same) in the ''Connected Services'' list, click {button Sign Out} next to that device/service to remove it.
;[[Image:FxAConnectedDevices]]
The current device will be listed first, followed by the most recent Sync device/service sign-ins.

=How do I use my Mozilla account on my devices?=
